notes: If angiography (i.e. within 24 h) is anticipated, enoxaparin should be considered as an alternative to UFH. (Class IIa, Level B)

recommendations.clinical_context: Patients with atrial fibrillation after an ACS event
recommendations.criteria: CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥1 in men and ≥2 in women; after up to 1 week of triple antithrombotic therapy following the ACS event
recommendations.recommendation: Dual antithrombotic therapy using a NOAC at the recommended dose for stroke prevention plus a single oral antiplatelet agent (preferably clopidogrel) for up to 12 months is recommended.

recommendations.criteria: Any of the following circumstances: patient is on a NOAC; or INR <2.5 in VKA-treated patients
recommendations.recommendation: A UFH bolus is recommended during PCI.

content.preferred_antiplatelet: clopidogrel (single oral antiplatelet agent preferred when used with a NOAC)
